decisions.reason: Because the mobile check-in app is closely related to the firm's airport passenger-processing and technology activities, its in-house development capabilities give it enough absorptive capacity to refine it, though the app is somewhat easier to discontinue than more embedded operational systems.

This passenger processing technology line fits the firm's established airport security and operational expertise very closely, and as a multi-model technology product it is the kind of adjacent innovation a large firm with in-house technology development is likely to retain and improve.

The self-service airline check-in solution builds on the firm's existing airport and passenger-handling knowledge, so management is likely to keep it as a commercially applicable extension of what the firm already knows, despite some uncertainty from limited later website evidence.
